programme.desc: With her wooden spoon, Donna threatens to derail Melissa and Louie; Brittney considers giving Andy the slip; Mikey has a heartbreaking reunion; Sharae has a secret; Joynomi investigates adoption with Redd, an inmate she's never met in person.

programme.title: Rome's Not Where the Heart Is
programme.desc: Love conflicts with the truth for Raneka; Melissa and Louie's first date goes south; marriage-talk mortifies Chelsea; Kerok bumps against Bri's baby timeline; Redd's mom's revelation shocks Joy; Andy hopes things heat up when Brittney comes home.

programme.title: Unhappy Father's Day
programme.desc: Bri and Kerok seek her disapproving dad's blessing; Louie seeks shelter from a jealous Melissa; Andy smothers Brit, who fears she'll return to old habits; Joynomi learns of Redd's shady dealings; Sharae's party faces legal jeopardy.

programme.title: Seeing Redd
programme.desc: Joy finally meets Redd after seven years, but he's holding a secret; Brittany demands her money; Melissa confronts a costly decision; Anthony wants a ring to rectify a lie; shocking news derails Chelsea and Mikey.

programme.title: Here Comes the Lie
programme.desc: Anthony confronts Sharae's ex; Redd decides to give Joy a taste of her own medicine with an old flame; Bri and Kerok clash over priorities; Chelsea fears Mikey's daughter won't accept her; Melissa leaves Georgia as Donna tightens her apron strings.

programme.title: The Fatal Journey
programme.desc: The Virginian poses as an ex-convict to infiltrate an outlaw gang guilty of a woman's murder, but finds his cover threatened by the arrival of another new member (David McLean); guest Robert Lansing.

programme.title: Man of Violence
programme.desc: Trampas acquires unwanted help (Peggy McCay, DeForest Kelley, Michael Pate) when he helps a woman seek her missing husband, an outlaw who has killed Trampas' friend; guest Leonard Nimoy.

programme.title: Fortunes of J. Jimerson Jones
programme.desc: Garth, Betsy and a hotel maid (Ann Doran) try to protect a suddenly wealthy prospector (Pat O'Brien) from a blonde's (Jeanne Cooper) schemes.

programme.title: The Thirty Days of Gavin Heath
programme.desc: After a bite from a rabid dog leaves him with little time to live, a Britisher (Leo Genn) embarks on a rescue mission to relieve his guilt over wartime cowardice.

programme.title: Smile of the Dragon
programme.desc: Trampas' wallet winds up on a dead man after a stagecoach robbery, leaving the ranch hand to be mistaken for one of the outlaws and accused of his own murder; guests Miyoshi Umeki, Richard Carlson.

programme.title: The Intruders
programme.desc: An outlaw (Darrin McGavin) and his men seize Shiloh and lie in wait for a chief (Iron Eyes Cody) and a general coming to negotiate a treaty; guest David Carradine.

programme.title: First to Thine Own Self
programme.desc: A youth (Randy Boone) aids a little girl, then is accused of murdering the child's grandfather (Frank Maxwell), a gold prospector; guest Bruce Dern.

programme.title: The Long Quest
programme.desc: A widow (Patricia Breslin) may lose her adopted son when a woman (Ruta Lee) plans to sue for custody of the boy, heir to a fortune; guest Joseph Campanella.

programme.title: The Secret of Brynmar Hall
programme.desc: A woman invites Betsy and three friends for the weekend, convinced that one is responsible for her daughter's death.

programme.title: Rope of Lies
programme.desc: Steve takes a job as foreman at a ranch owned by a beautiful woman (Diana Hillary), who has plans for the unsuspecting wrangler that involve a confrontation with her violent former lover.

programme.title: A Man Called Kane
programme.desc: Randy's discovery of gold coins hidden in a cave on the Shiloh Ranch attracts visitors -- a government agent seeking Civil War loot and Randy's long-lost brother, who is wanted for murder.

programme.title: Dark Destiny
programme.desc: An outlaw's (Robert Wilke) tomboy daughter (Brenda Scott), placed in the Virginian's care, is torn between her devotion to injured Randy and her desire to help her father escape from jail.

programme.title: A Bride for Lars
programme.desc: Indians, outlaws and temptation make Trampas rue delivering a Swedish mail-order bride (Katherine Crawford) to an injured neighbor (Peter Whitney).

programme.title: Felicity's Spring
programme.desc: A new schoolteacher (Katherine Crawford) wins the heart of Medicine Bow, until her sister (Mariette Hartley) reveals her fatal flaw.

programme.title: All Nice & Legal
programme.desc: A lawyer (Anne Francis) wins the acceptance of Medicine Bow's people by helping the Virginian in a legal matter, but loses favor when she uses her skills to free three outlaws from jail.

programme.title: A Father for Toby
programme.desc: A boy (Kurt Russell) complicates Trampas' romance with a teacher by claiming to be his son; then the father (Rory Calhoun), an ex-convict, arrives.

programme.title: Man of the People
programme.desc: Garth opposes a congressman's (James Dunn) plan to settle immigrants on barren land; guests Arthur Space, Martin West, Brendan Dillon.

programme.title: Return of a Stranger
programme.desc: The tactics of his son (Peter Brown) and an associate (Whit Bissell) threaten a prospector's (Leif Erickson) dream of operating a silver mine.

programme.title: Portrait of a Widow
programme.desc: Garth tells a widow (Vera Miles) that her French portraitist (John Gavin) is a swindler out to get a valuable work of art.

programme.title: The Stallion
programme.desc: Randy recaptures an injured stallion that killed a rider and takes it to a former veterinarian (Robert Culp); guest Donald Barry.

programme.title: Dark Challenge
programme.desc: A rancher (Victor Jory) looking to buy a husband for his crippled daughter (Katharine Ross) offers Trampas a foreman's job and half-interest in the spread; guest Chris Robinson.

programme.title: The Hero
programme.desc: Trampas suspects a writer (Steve Forrest) doing a story on possible senatorial-candidate Garth may be working with a lawyer (Warren Stevens) to threaten the jurist with blackmail.

programme.title: The Girl From Yesterday
programme.desc: Steve decides to romance a woman (Ruta Lee) from his past in order to clear her name; guest Mark Richman.

programme.title: Big Image ... Little Man
programme.desc: A millionaire (Linden Chiles) dumped off a train joins the Virginian's cattle drive, but rebels against orders to earn his keep as a cook's helper and plots revenge against the Virginian; guest Slim Pickens.

programme.title: The Brazos Kid
programme.desc: A magazine writer's imaginings put bounty hunters on the trail of the Virginian; guest Skip Homeier.

programme.title: We've Lost a Train
programme.desc: A series of misadventures plagues Trampas as he travels to Mexico on Shiloh business.

programme.title: Hour of the Tiger
programme.desc: A rancher (Tom Tully) refuses to allow cattle belonging to Garth to escape a landslide by crossing his land; the Virginian falls in love with a Chinese laborer (Cely Carrillo).

programme.title: A Gallows for Sam Horn
programme.desc: An immigrant waitress (Laurel Goodwin) disappears with evidence in a rancher's (John Lupton) shooting of a railroad magnate's (Edward Binns) son; guest George Kennedy.

programme.title: Two Men Named Laredo
programme.desc: Judge Garth delves into psychology to comprehend a gentle, poetry-reading cowboy (Fabian) accused of two brutal murders; guests Ford Rainey, Elizabeth MacRae.

programme.title: A Slight Case of Charity
programme.desc: While in Albuquerque, Trampas pretends to be a hired gunfighter to romance a beautiful woman (Kathryn Hays) who is practicing a puzzling deception of her own; guests Warren Oates, Les Tremayne.

programme.title: Ryker
programme.desc: Ryker wants to shed his reputation as a hired gun but faces a murder charge and a former partner; guests Leslie Nielsen, Anne Helm, Raquel Welch.

programme.title: Farewell to Honesty
programme.desc: After the Virginian accuses a prominent citizen (Richard Carlson) of forgery in the town of Honesty, he faces a murder charge; guests Kathleen Crowley, Harold Gould.

programme.title: You Take the High Road
programme.desc: A young man (Richard Beymer) pulls a gun when the Virginian blocks his herd, which may be carrying tick fever; guest Diana Lynn.

programme.title: The Payment
programme.desc: Ryker firmly believes his stepfather (Lloyd Nolan) has reformed and ignores evidence indicating the older man is gathering people for a new outlaw gang; guest Bruce Dern.

programme.title: Legend for a Lawman
programme.desc: A marshal (Ford Rainey) who believes he is infallible arrests Randy for a murder that occurred during a bank robbery; guests Adam West, William Stevens.

programme.title: Maverick - A Technical Error
programme.desc: Bart Maverick wins a bank in a poker game but discovers the previous owner, who was anxious to get rid of it, unloaded it due to a $20,000 bookkeeping shortage. Now, Bart must deal with the famous Doc Holliday and try to prevent a run on the bank.

programme.title: Maverick - The People's Friend
programme.desc: Bart Maverick runs for senator in Silverdale after rescuing Reform Party candidate Ellsworth Greeley from an assassination attempt. Bart's campaign run becomes dangerous when his enemies intend to kill him if he wins, forcing him to throw the race.

programme.title: Cheyenne - The Quick and the Deadly
programme.desc: On his stop to pick up prisoners for Huntsville, Cheyenne learns of Deputy Gary Thomas' conviction of a crime. He believes that the banker's son, Jud Ainley is behind Thomas' arrest and begins unraveling the truth.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Deadeye Kid
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, 16 year-old Donnel O'Mahoney panics and comes to the McCain Ranch. A posse is on the hunt for the young man, believing he commited the crime. Mark befriends and hides O'Mahoney, who is traveling west from New York.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Indian
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart escorts an Indian prisoner back east to stand trial. They arrive in North Fork and Lucas finds out that Buckhart is also an Indian who was educated at Harvard. Angry townspeople try to take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: F Troop - The Return of Wrongo Starr
programme.desc: The jinxed cavalryman, Wrongo Starr, comes back to Fort Courage. However, this time he is making the F Troop very nervous with a load of dynamite in his possession. While there, he gets mixed up with a goat after Parmenter assigns him as a guard.

programme.title: F Troop - Survival of the Fittest
programme.desc: An army captain arrives at Fort Courage and tells Captain Permenter that two troops must undergo a survival test in the wilderness. Parmenter decides to go with Agarn. Realizing they must survive on their own, the two face challenges finding food.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - The Bone War
programme.desc: It's not gold that inspires a rush of treasure hunters to flood the windblown bluffs of Wyoming: it's bones. After stumbling upon a strange fossil, a man is caught in the crossfire of rival paleontologists warring over a trove of dinosaur bones.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - The Gold Rush Lawman
programme.desc: When failed prospector John Hicks Adams is elected sheriff of Santa Clara County, he must prove that he won't be a bust as a lawman too. Just weeks into the job, his courage is tested when a band of stagecoach robbers begins terrorizing the area.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - Lewis & Clark: Captains of Discovery
programme.desc: Under orders from President Jefferson to explore America's vast unknown frontier, Meriwether Lewis and William Clark lead an expedition up the Missouri River in an attempt to reach the Pacific Ocean...a journey no American has made before, and one that may not even be possible. Leaving Fort Mandan after their first winter on the frontier, the Corps of Discovery enters completely uncharted territory. But as the waterways they travel become too shallow for boats, Lewis and Clark desperately seek t

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - Cash Cows
programme.desc: First, the cowboys need to track down one of Bubba's most troublesome heifers before she can bust through his fence again. After briefly tending to business and family in Alabama, the guys head back to the Lone Star State to try and expand their network of contacts. Bubba, Cody, and Booger help their new friend Cash with a big Texas cattle drive in the hopes of both leading the herd to greener pastures and finding the big cattle deal they came west for. On the range they forge deeper bonds with

programme.title: Maverick - Prey of the Cat
programme.desc: Bart Maverick suffers a broken leg after a mountain lion spooks his horse. He recuperates at the secluded Star Trail Ranch owned by Pete Stillman. However, Pete's wife, Kitty, is enamored with Bart and develops a different plan of her own for him.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Outcast of Cripple Creek
programme.desc: After his friend passes away, Cheyenne becomes the marshal of Cripple Creek. Disgusted by all the corruption in the small town, he resigns. His successor arrives but may need Cheyenne's help to keep the peace.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Alibi for the Scalped Man
programme.desc: Cheyenne travels to Emmetville for his friend's wedding. When he arrives in town, he finds out that his friend is missing. Suspicious arise around the tight-lipped Emmet family and the bride-to-be who doesn't seemed concerned of his whereabouts.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Assault
programme.desc: Traveling salesman Speed Sullivan, and his son, Swifty, come to North Fork selling lightning rods. Sullivan makes a call at Vashti Croxton's home where he finds her unconscious. When she blames Sullivan for the assault, Lucas must intervene.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Short Rope for a Tall Man
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark travel to a nearby town to sell a bull. While in town, they buy two horses from Mr. Schneider, a man in a hurry. When a posse stops Lucas and Mark on the way home, Lucas learns the horses were stolen. The men want Lucas to hang.

programme.title: Maverick - A Technical Error
programme.desc: Bart Maverick wins a bank in a poker game but discovers the previous owner, who was anxious to get rid of it, unloaded it due to a $20,000 bookkeeping shortage. Now, Bart must deal with the famous Doc Holliday and try to prevent a run on the bank.

programme.title: Maverick - A Flock of Trouble
programme.desc: Bret Maverick wins a massive sheep herd in a poker game from a rancher named Big Coley. However, the sheep are located on territory in the middle of a violent range war. When the cattlemen want his sheep gone, Bret finds a way to fight back.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Indian Gold
programme.desc: Sioux brave White Crow needs medical help for his sick wife, Little Fawn. Cheyenne and Doc Farnsworth leave to go see her. When White Crow returns with gold as payment to heal her, the locals want to invade Sioux territory, possibly starting a war.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Boarding House
programme.desc: Julia Andueza opens a boarding house in North Fork. Lucas remembers her as a dishonest card dealer from the past. Her old boss arrives and tries to bully Julia into turning her business into a gambling house. Lucas realizes she has changed her ways.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Second Witness
programme.desc: Lucas' life is in danger after he agrees to testify in a murder case in another town. The only other witness was killed, and when a gun-toting stranger appears at the McCain Ranch, Lucas now finds himself in grave danger.

programme.title: Maverick - Escape to Tampico
programme.desc: Bret Maverick travels to Mexico to find a man wanted for murder, then bring him back to New Orleans. He soon finds the supposed killer, a bartender named Steve Corbett. The two become friends, but only after Bret believes in his innocence.

programme.desc: After a bank robbery, two Pinkerton detectives join forces to track the notorious Missouri Kid. During a shootout, the Missouri Kid kills seasoned detective Charles Schumacher, leaving young George Dougherty to finish the job and avenge his death.

programme.desc: Unable to apprehend the train-robbing Smith Brothers, Sheriff Doc Shores calls the Pinkerton Detective Agency for assistance. The agency sends Charles Siringo, an undercover specialist known for his unorthodox methods of capturing criminals.

programme.desc: As a member of Lewis and Clark's Corps of Discovery, John Colter travels from the Missouri River all the way to the Pacific Ocean, but he decides not to return to the civilized East when the expedition ends. programme.desc: With talks of a Civil War brewing, Southern saboteurs know they must keep Northern forces from using the U.S. train system. They devise a daring and dangerous plan to stop and capture a railroad engine, preventing the completion of a railroad line.

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger - A Shard of Glass
programme.desc: Haunted by the memory of leaving a man to die, mountain man Jim Bridger is determined not to repeat the mistake. When his trapping party runs out of water while crossing a barren desert, Bridger struggles desperately to keep his companions alive.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Trade
programme.desc: Outlaw Sam Morley, an old friend, comes to the McCain Ranch. He asks Lucas to turn in him for the $500 reward and use the money to pay for his girlfriend's medical care. However, a bounty hunter has other ideas.

programme.title: The Rifleman - One Went to Denver
programme.desc: Tom Birch, an old childhood friend, comes to visit Lucas unexpectedly. Birch promises he is just passing through on his way to Denver. But Lucas soon finds out about a plot to rob the North Fork Bank and must choose between friendship and justice.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Deadly Wait
programme.desc: Just released from prison, Dan Maury comes to North Fork in search of Marshal Micah Torrance, who helped get him locked up. Torrance carries a shotgun everywhere he goes, but Maury plans to wait him out.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Wrong Man
programme.desc: A crooked marshal comes to North Fork looking for a wanted man. He finds a man fitting the futitive's description. He deliberately kills the wrong man to collect the bounty and then blackmails the real outlaw, who wants to keep his past hidden.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - Bass Reeves Tracks Belle Starr
programme.desc: As U.S. Marshal Bass Reeves attempts to arrest Belle Starr and her outlaw husband, Belle asks for 24 hours to find someone to care for her young daughter, Pearl. When the Starr family decides to flee instead, the Marshal must track them down.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - Billy the Kid: Birth of an Outlaw
programme.desc: Teenaged fugitive William Bonney is given a second chance when a kindhearted ranch owner offers him a job. But when his new employer is killed in cold blood, Bonney reverts to his criminal ways, seeking vengeance and transforming into Billy the Kid.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - Jim Bridger: Forged on the Frontier
programme.desc: With dreams of fortune and adventure, an 18-year-old Jim Bridger joins William Ashley's expedition to trap beaver along the Missouri River. But a grim ordeal soon forces Bridger to weigh his morals against the harsh reality of survival in the wild. A vicious grizzly bear attack leaves fellow trapper and hunter Hugh Glass on the verge of death and completely dependent upon Bridger's care. As a hostile band of Arikara warriors begins to close in, Bridger must choose between staying with the dying

programme.title: Maverick - The Long Hunt
programme.desc: A dying outlaw named Lefty Dolan asks Bret Maverick to clear a man who was wrongly convicted of bank robbery. Maverick embarks on a year-long quest across the Wyoming and Arizona territories to find Jedd Ferris and clear him of the crime.

programme.title: Maverick - The Spanish Dancer
programme.desc: Bart Maverick and Gentleman Jack Darby team up with an exotic Spanish dancer named Elena Grande to win a flooded mine from its crooked owner, John Wilson. Their scheme involves a staged fight and the fake murder of Darby.

programme.title: Blood on the Arrow
programme.desc: After an escaped outlaw survives an Indian attack in the Arizona Territory, he is determined to help a trading-post family retrieve their kidnapped son from raiding Apache Indians.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Mescalero Curse
programme.desc: Lucas serves as a jury foreman when a Mescalero Apache Indian is found guilty of murder and is hanged. A Mescalero medicine man places a curse on Lucas. At first Lucas brushes it off, then unusual events begin to happen including a ghost stallion.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Stopover
programme.desc: A brutal snowstorm makes the roads impassable and forces a stagecoach to stop at the McCain Ranch. Lucas gives the passengers shelter, but little does he know a dance hall girl, a drunk, and a famous gunslinger are his guests.

programme.title: Maverick - Mr. Muldoon's Partner
programme.desc: When Bart Maverick frees and partners with a supposed leprechaun named Mr. Muldoon from Ireland, in gratitude he rewards Bart with five wishes. However, each wish seems to only get Bart into more trouble: from stolen money, to murder, to marriage.

programme.title: The One That Got Out
programme.desc: Multiple women are murdered during a Texas police hunt for a serial killer.

programme.title: Diary of a Killer
programme.desc: When a beloved mother is killed, police uncover clues in the accused killer's diary.

programme.title: All American Murder
programme.desc: When a Texas couple is murdered in their bed, authorities investigate whether the culprit is a masked intruder or someone closer to home.

programme.title: Three Shots in the Dark
programme.desc: When a pro athlete is murdered, police embark on an international chase for the killer.

programme.title: Missing From the Mall
programme.desc: When a college student vanishes from a mall parking lot, police hunt her killer.

programme.title: There Is a Monster in Me
programme.desc: When a woman is killed in small-town Texas, a secret diary reveals the killer's motive.

programme.title: The Murderer in the Minivan
programme.desc: Three women -- one missing, one murdered, one kidnapped -- and the clues leading to a killer.

programme.title: Sealed With a Kill
programme.desc: An inside look at an undercover investigation involving conspiracy, escorts and murder for hire.

programme.title: Love. Honor. Betray.
programme.desc: John Quiñones reports on the story of a young husband, father and soldier murdered while at home for the holidays; interrogation tapes and extensive police body camera footage reveal a twisted tale of heartache and greed.

programme.title: A Killer Renovation
programme.desc: A Florida mom's mysterious death leads authorities to investigate the connection to a missing engagement ring, a disastrous home renovation, and a popular TV home-makeover show.

programme.title: Killer on Campus
programme.desc: A Florida university campus is on edge when a student disappears; police say love, lies and obsession led to murder; a new witness comes forward with a claim that could potentially overturn the case.

programme.title: Into the Darkness
programme.desc: More than a decade after a teenage girl vanishes from a popular tourist destination, her killer is brought to justice; interviews with the FBI team who broke the case wide open and identified her killer.

programme.title: Highway Hunter
programme.desc: When four young women go missing, police hunt for a serial killer roaming the interstate; John Quiñones explores the families' quests for answers.

programme.title: Ruby Franke: From Momfluencer to Felon
programme.desc: Ruby Franke is a popular YouTuber known for her strict parenting; after her emaciated son escapes, begging for help, her seemingly perfect world implodes; featuring all-new body camera footage, recorded calls and a look at Ruby's private journal.

programme.title: Am I Next?
programme.desc: When a young couple is found dead, police learn they were involved in an online feud and uncover a deadly catfishing scheme; "20/20" untangles the web of lies and unmasks the unlikely mastermind behind the murders.

programme.title: How'd You Rather Die?
programme.desc: When a 16-year-old girl disappears, police have a surveillance video showing her getting into an unknown vehicle shortly after midnight; when the truth of her disappearance finally comes to light, the community is shocked by who is behind the plot.

programme.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: A beloved small-town minister is found killed in his family home and his wife and three children are nowhere to be found.

programme.title: The Hungryland Homicides
programme.desc: When a young mother goes missing, police question a pastor, the ex-husband and even a local ventriloquist.

programme.title: Forever 17
programme.desc: When two teen girls never make it home after a night out, authorities discover their dead bodies in the trunk of a car; detectives go to exhaustive lengths to identify the killer, but it takes decades before they zero in on a very unlikely suspect.

programme.title: The Unkindest Cut
programme.desc: When a beloved celebrity hairstylist is found murdered in his home, authorities consider whether it was a burglary gone wrong or something more sinister.

programme.title: A Deadly Scream
programme.desc: After the largest investigation in Tennessee's history, a key witness recants his testimony when the remains of a 20-year-old nursing student are found three years after her disappearance.

programme.title: Follow the Fingerprints
programme.desc: In the eyes of the law, a man killed his first wife, but his second wife thinks he is innocent; incredible new developments take this investigation in a completely new direction, as John Quiñones reports on the crime, the courts and the confession.

programme.title: To Have and to Hoax
programme.desc: Interview with Keith Papini after his ex-wife, Sherri Papini, served 10 months in prison for lying to federal agents about her fabricated kidnapping.

programme.title: Night Terror
programme.desc: A couple is murdered inside their home, possibly by someone trying to hide a secret double life.

programme.title: Karen Read: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Karen Read answers questions surrounding the night at issue in her controversial trial.

programme.title: The Pointe of No Return
programme.desc: Features an interview with Ashley Benefield, the woman at the center of the so-called "Black Swan Trial."

programme.title: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: An Illinois man jokes on national TV that he regrets his marriage; a couple of months later, his wife is murdered; authorities wonder whether a ghostly figure on a bike caught on surveillance video could be the killer.

programme.title: No Trace
programme.desc: A situation involving a husband, a wife and a young bar hostess results in a disappearance.

programme.title: Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: A high school love story turns deadly.

programme.title: Tangled Web
programme.desc: A couple is stalked, a woman goes missing, and one cellphone holds the key.

programme.title: Deadly Night
programme.desc: A home invasion and shooting may have a sinister motive.

programme.title: Shattered Love
programme.desc: A beloved young mother is found murdered in her bedroom closet; the incredible investigation leads to multiple trials and a 24-year search for justice.

programme.title: Guatemala
programme.desc: Fresh bull testicle ceviche and possum Sunday dinner in Guatemala where ancient flavors are still alive.

programme.title: Croatia's Dalmatian Coast
programme.desc: Ancient tastes in Croatia like roasted dormice and giant offal kebabs to baked rooster and grilled frog.

programme.title: Paris Reborn: Cow Heads, Caves
programme.desc: Mushrooms harvested in underground caves; brined ham delivered to the presidential palace; aging artisanal French cheese.

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Cheese-steak and shad cake to turkey neck and pig liver in Philadelphia where pride brings good food.

programme.title: Oaxaca
programme.desc: Winged ants, grilled intestines, grasshoppers and dried beef hearts enjoyed in Mexico's culinary capital.

programme.title: Amsterdam
programme.desc: Unique re-inventions of traditional Dutch recipes in Amsterdam from goose croquettes to insect-filled nuggets to smoked local eel and hollow pig head.

programme.title: Kansas City Snoots and Spleens
programme.desc: Andrew tours Kansas City for pig snoots, backyard woodchuck and BBQ.

programme.title: Jerusalem
programme.desc: Andrew travels to Jerusalem for tastes older than the city itself; he tries cow udder, veal brain, turkey balls and mullet roe.

programme.title: Madrid
programme.desc: Andrew visits Madrid for pig heads, organ omelets and duck liver jewelry.

programme.title: Senegal
programme.desc: Andrew harvests ancient sea salt, roasts a sheep's head and fishes the wild waters in Senegal's West African culture.

programme.title: North Carolina
programme.desc: Andrew tastes pig appendix and raw turtle testicle; hunting feral hogs and brewing ancestral pot likker.

programme.title: The Bronx
programme.desc: In the Bronx, Andrew tries coyote and raw clams from Long Island Sound.

programme.title: Okinawa
programme.desc: Andrew visits Okinawa, Japan, to taste poisonous pufferfish and raw goat.

programme.title: Shanghai
programme.desc: Andrew goes to Shanghai for softshell turtle, snail shells and live snake.

programme.title: Stockholm
programme.desc: Putrefied herring; smoked sperm; reindeer testicle; aged horse meat; high-end hot dogs; whiskey goose blood soup.

programme.title: Cyprus
programme.desc: Stuffed grape leaves and pork belly in Cyprus; curdling goat milk and sampling sun-dried goat; the world's oldest cookie.

programme.title: Lewis and Clark Trail
programme.desc: Andrew follows in the footsteps of Lewis and Clark while experiencing the bountiful cuisine of the Pacific Northwest; sampling Pacific lampreys, forages for edible barnacles and harvests for sea salt on this culinary adventure.

programme.title: The Southern BBQ Trail
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern eats his way through the Southern BBQ Trail; dry-aged brisket in Atlanta; liver nip dumplings in South Carolina; raccoon hash in Hull, Georgia.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern sinks his teeth into the foods that have sustained soldiers and civilians since the lean times of the Civil War and shaped a region's cuisine, from barbecued raccoon and squirrel stew to tooth-cracking hard tack.

programme.title: Road Tripping Route 66
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern sets off on historic Route 66, where he tries ranch dressing soda, judges a calf fry cook-off and dines at some of the most iconic diners along the world-famous highway; quail stew, onion burgers and ox tail.

programme.title: Great Lakes
programme.desc: From pork shoulder cooked underground to hearty pasties and whitefish plucked from the tumultuous Lake Superior, Andrew Zimmern explores the cuisine of the individualistic Upper Peninsula in Michigan.

programme.title: The Pacific Coast Highway
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern cruises up the most scenic highway in America on a seafood-sampling adventure; hagfish fishing in the Pacific, eating the slimy reproductive organs of sea urchins and foraging for juicy gooseneck barnacles.

programme.title: Magnificent Mississippi River
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern follows Mark Twain's path down the Mississippi River for a slice of Americana; floating from meal to meal, he tries frog legs on a cargo ship, hunts wood duck, grills huge fish ribs and learns the art of Deep South pheasant pot pie.

programme.title: Cajun Country Trail
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern heads south to explore Louisiana's Cajun country; from blood sausage to chewy ginger cakes, seafood gumbo to wild hog heart, Andrew finds that Cajun country is rife with edible resources and French-inspired recipes from the past.

programme.title: Twin Cities
programme.desc: Old-fashioned is combined with modern innovation to create some interesting comfort foods in Minneapolis and St. Paul.

programme.title: New Orleans
programme.desc: Bizarre Foods America visits the Big Easy where the food and the culture are a mix of Southern traditions and modern influence. Andrew eats stuffed pig stomach and smoked raccoon served with a side of live jazz.

programme.title: Seattle
programme.desc: Andrew visits Seattle, where the food scene can be high-tech or ruggedly simple. He's an eyewitness to how complicated gadgets create brand-new tastes, and he visits an all-natural farm to eat cow placenta.

programme.title: Boston
programme.desc: Andrew visits Boston to prove that a traditional city can be a breeding ground for new food trends. He meets a group of Harvard scientists, and a Cambodian family that injects new food traditions into a Boston suburb.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Andrew finds out if it is food that keeps Detroit's motor running. Andrew visits Motown and gets revved up about tasting some of the city's food, including iconic soul food and lamb brain sandwiches, in the heart of Arab America.

programme.title: West Virginia
programme.desc: West Virginia's culinary delights are celebrated, including fresh deer organs after a kill, groundhog burgoo, and a roadkill cook-off.

programme.title: Charleston
programme.desc: Andrew gets a taste of the rewards from hard work and discovers the true flavor of Charleston's food scene.

programme.title: Savannah
programme.desc: Andrew tastes the cultural influences of the Southern city of Savannah on the sea and dines with The Lady Chablis.

programme.title: Las Vegas
programme.desc: Hamburger that costs five thousand dollars; a seafood restaurant that has an Italian fish market flown in every day; dinner for 1,800 people at Muhammad Ali's 70th birthday.

programme.title: San Diego
programme.desc: From wild vegetables to wild animals, Andrew gets a taste of the unexpected when he visits San Diego.

programme.title: Miami
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern tracks down the iconic treasures and hidden delights that make Miami's food scene so special.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: Zimmern explores the many layers of flavors from the past and present that can be found in this southwestern state.

programme.title: L.A. Pop Up
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates a menu inspired by his travels around the world for a hungry dinner crowd in LA.

programme.title: Austin
programme.desc: Bloody Mary's made with real blood, whole roasted pigeons, donuts topped with chicken and milkshakes made with bacon.

programme.title: The Blues Trail
programme.desc: Andrew tastes everything from southern staples like smoked baloney sandwiches, deep-fried chicken livers, and pork rinds, to new spins on old staples.

programme.title: The Other Florida
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern goes deep into the interior of Florida and discovers that people in the rural areas are still living off the land and eating much like their ancestors did.

programme.title: Washington D.C.
programme.desc: Fresh snakehead pulled from the Potomac; pupusas at a Salvadoran restaurant; peanut butter sandwiches made with foie gras.

programme.title: Denver
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain oysters at a ballpark; yak and elk served at an historic restaurant; pheasant cooked outside.

programme.title: Iowa
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern finds out that there's a lot more than meat and potatoes on the table in Iowa; pork brains with spring onion kimchi; a stew made from a sheep's head.

programme.title: Alaska's Inside Passage
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern gets a whole new taste of Alaska's Inside Passage. Fresh sea cucumbers; salmon eggs; fish heads.

programme.title: Wisconsin
programme.desc: Science behind what makes milk taste better; a traditional Serbian casserole made with lamb organs; emu testicles.

programme.title: Chicago's Cutting Edge
programme.desc: A fish dish made with ambergris; charcuterie that includes duck heart pate; a soup that smells like a dead body.

programme.title: Baltimore and Chesapeake Bay
programme.desc: Beef tongue sandwiches; Korean soul foods that include boiled pig stomach and blood sausage; traditional bay foods like barbecued muskrat and grilled eel.

programme.title: The Ozarks
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern makes a trip to the Ozarks where people are still living off the land and making the most of it by combining old traditions with new techniques.

programme.title: Northern California
programme.desc: Andrew visits northern California where people are reinventing the way they look at food. Grilled dove hearts; barf flavored jelly beans; monkey face eel.

programme.title: Portland
programme.desc: Elk heart tartar with a raw turkey egg; bourbon smoked cherries and bone marrow; goose liver with cacao.

programme.title: Hidden Los Angeles
programme.desc: Andrew finds out that some of the best foods in LA are hiding deep inside city neighborhoods; pig head tamales; steamed chicken embryo.

programme.title: Undiscovered Hawaii
programme.desc: Andrew wants to find out what Hawaiians really like to eat; dried octopus bile sac; crispy pork intestine;and a traditional take on a raw fish salad that includes the eyeballs.

programme.title: The Third Coast
programme.desc: Andrew visits the forgotten Gulf shore where people strive to preserve their own unique way of life; stingray tacos; pan fried duck testicles; nutria stew.

programme.title: Queens, New York
programme.desc: A Pakistani kebab joint with a dish made out of goat liver and brains; a Tibetan place with soup made from yak meat; buffalo chicken feet with maple syrup.

programme.title: Birmingham: The New South
programme.desc: A Chinese style noodle bowl made with frog legs and pig skin; sautéed rabbit offal and goat head soup.

programme.title: Rhode Island
programme.desc: Andrew visits Rhode Island where old traditions meet the experimental to create clam cakes and monkfish liver mousse.

programme.title: Louisville: Bourbon and Burgoo
programme.desc: Andrew visits Louisville, KY, when he tastes its unique foods; barbecued sheep meat, pork brain sandwiches and burgoo, a hunter's stew made with squirrel.

programme.title: St. Croix
programme.desc: Andrew visits St. Croix in the U.S. Virgin Islands, where he discovers a diverse cultural melting pot of food. Goat water soup; conch roti; breadfruit tostones.

programme.title: St. Louis
programme.desc: Brain sandwiches and crispy pig snouts; pig heart pastrami; dessert made with organ meats and caramel sauce.

programme.title: Houston
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern gets a taste of the vibrant city of Houston. From a tailgating feast featuring buffalo to a blast and cast that nets fresh duck organs and grilled redfish.

programme.title: New Jersey
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern finds out that some amazing things are growing in America's Garden State; dinuguan; Taylor pork roll.

programme.desc: A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments featuring defiant defendants: a man representing himself in court has several outbursts; a defendant who won't stop talking; a judge keeps his cool when a man loudly objects to his bail amount; and more.

programme.title: Episode 40
programme.desc: The judge loses his patience with a man accused of drunk boating; a defendant waiting outside the courtroom is physically assaulted; a woman being sued for back rent screams at the judge during her virtual hearing.

programme.title: Episode 32
programme.desc: Chaos erupts as a defendant attacks the bailiff; a convicted murderer calls the detectives in his case idiots; a defendant keeps firing his court-appointed lawyers; and more.

programme.title: Episode 29
programme.desc: A man convicted of double murder elbows his own attorney in the face; a defendant misses his virtual hearing by falling asleep; the judge loses his patience during a tenant/landlord dispute; and more.

programme.title: Episode 26
programme.desc: The courtroom erupts into chaos during a hearing for a murder case; the judge chastises a defendant for making horrible decisions; a prosecutor strongly disagrees with what he feels is an unreasonable sentence from the judge.

programme.title: Episode 24
programme.desc: A convicted cop killer goes on an f-bomb tirade in court; a defendant reveals his fandom for the judge before that same judge admonishes him for bad behavior in virtual court; the family of a murder victim lashes out at the killer - a family friend.

programme.title: Episode 23
programme.desc: A murder victim's family member attacks the defendant in the courtroom; a man angers the judge by smoking a cigarette during his virtual hearing; a juvenile defendant's mom is told to leave the courtroom after complaining about her son's lawyer.
