programme.title: Muslim Empires: Land, Language, Religion
programme.desc: The geographical region known as Greater Middle East; the range of nations and cultures that define it; historical turning points to witness, encompassing conquests, political alliances and Islam's rise; social, intellectual and economic reforms.

programme.title: Muhammad and the Dawn of Islam - 622
programme.desc: Islam's rise is a major turning point; tracing key phases in the life of Muhammad (PBUH); the founding of the faith through his years of opposition; his establishment of Islam as a religious and political entity; the global impact of these events.

programme.title: From Camels to Stars in the Middle East
programme.desc: One of the most important yet overlooked periods in human history; the who, what, why, where, when and how of the Golden Age of Islamic Civilization; exploring the Abbasid Empire; how it bridged the ancient world and the Renaissance.

programme.title: Ibn Battuta's Search for Knowledge
programme.desc: Meeting the Moroccan wayfarer Ibn Battuta; tracing his journey across Northern Africa and the Middle East in the century after the Mongol sack of Baghdad; new insights into the era, including whether it ever truly come to an end.

programme.title: Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon
programme.desc: During the Third Crusade, the European soldiers spend the winter playing the ancient game of Tables, which would evolve into backgammon by the 20th century.

programme.title: Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
programme.desc: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game.

programme.title: A Meeting of Two Worlds
programme.desc: Introducing the themes of increasing American power; indigenous political aspirations; conflicting interests and goals; growing mutual antagonism; setting the stage for World War I.

programme.title: Wilson & the Breakup of the Ottoman Empire
programme.desc: An examination of wartime and postwar American policy; showing how Wilson's commitment to an ethnocentrically defined view of national self-determination drives his efforts to shape the postwar settlement in the Middle East.

programme.title: Uncovering Near Eastern Civilization
programme.desc: Egypt, Greece and Rome may be better known to the public; more written evidence survives from Mesopotamia; embarking on a journey through over 3,000 years of history; learning why Mesopotamia's rediscovery is so valuable.

programme.title: Natufian Villagers and Early Settlements
programme.desc: The enormous value of plant and animal domestication; the theories about the transition from a hunter-gatherer lifestyle to agriculture; the challenges that farming presents; a perspective on the cultural sophistication of pre-agrarian peoples.

programme.title: The Land of Canaan
programme.desc: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites.

programme.title: The Arrival of the Israelites
programme.desc: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges.

programme.title: The New Testament-An Overview
programme.desc: The course begins by addressing some of the basic facts about the New Testament; which books it contains, when they are written, in what language and by whom.

programme.title: Paul-Our Earliest Christian Author
programme.desc: The Epistles of Paul are the earliest books of the New Testament, predating even the Gospels; the realities of writing a letter in the ancient world; issues that affect how one understands Paul's Epistles and the other writings of the New Testament.

programme.title: Biblical Israel - The Story of a People
programme.desc: Entering the world of biblical Israel with a historical overview; an examination of how the Bible gives insights into the daily life of ancient Israelites; considering the context for how the Bible comes into being.

programme.title: By the Rivers of Babylon - Exile
programme.desc: A look at the Babylonian exile; the exiled Judeans begin asking themselves who they are as a people and why they are conquered; as the Bible begins to be compiled in this time of exile, it offers two vantage points for understanding its history.

programme.title: Volume 4
programme.desc: Scattered across the frozen Montana wilderness, The Arc's inmates discover that survival has turned every orange uniform into a target.

programme.title: Volume 5
programme.desc: Hunted through a frozen wilderness, FIVE makes a last stand against a hunter who is not programmed - and learns what ELI is willing to do to save him.

programme.title: Episodes 1-3
programme.desc: A rebel uncovers buried power in the ashes, hunts for his sister through a decaying jungle, and leads the final rebellion against the empire that broke their world. Three chapters. One reckoning. Includes behind-the-scenes footage.

programme.title: Black Harvest: From Embryom Chronicles
programme.desc: A lone Raider embarks on a cursed journey across a landscape of industrial decay and living horror. In search of a rare substance harvested within these poisoned lands, every step drags him deeper into the true cost of survival. Includes BTS footage.

programme.title: Elcano: Primus Circumdedisti Me
programme.desc: The untold story of Juan Sebastián Elcano, the man who finished Magellan's impossible voyage and became the first to sail around the world. A raw, violent, and intimate short film about survival, ambition, and the price of glory at sea.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: The burgers are wrong. The play area is infinite. There's something in the brine. MidBurger wishes you happy holidays and reminds you: we tried. That's enough.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: After years of war, Elijah Kelly returns home to Mill Ford - but the town is not empty, it is waiting. What he uncovers doesn't end with his homecoming; it's only the start of a fight to survive something far worse.

programme.title: Volume 2
programme.desc: Part of the gang rides for Walker Lake; Jake stays behind for a chance to walk away. But the desert has other plans - Elijah is hunted by something that knows his name, and Jake is captured by men guarding a relic of their own. The road to Walker Lake runs through both.

programme.title: Volume 3
programme.desc: At Walker Lake, Elijah meets a woman who pulls him deeper into himself - and toward a reckoning that reveals more evils loose in the world than anyone was prepared to face.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: Victoria Grey follows a shadow into the dark and finds something she was never meant to see. That same night, a ghost from the past arrives at dinner - and nothing will be the same again.

programme.title: Kelly Boesch Surreal Visuals and Sounds: Volume 4
programme.desc: A curated playlist of AI-created music videos by Kelly Boesch.

programme.title: surRIHL Presents: The Future Is Surreal
programme.desc: Reality bends as human imagination meets advanced AI. surRIHL presents a breathtaking cinematic descent into dreamcore worlds and high-impact visual poetry. The future isn't automated-it's beautifully, unpredictably surreal.

programme.title: Creatures of Faith
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic hunter discovers an ancient robot created by humans and must use its wisdom to save his tribe from extinction.

programme.title: Sci-Fi volume 2
programme.desc: From plots to destroy earth to ominous conspiracies - four sci-fi films spanning Earth, Mars, and the cosmos, where every universe hides a secret.

programme.title: Documentaries & Mockumentaries volume 1
programme.desc: From wartime Tobruk to the Blue Crown of Papua, from labor marches to inherited weapons - five AI-driven stories where objects carry memory and history shapes destiny.

programme.title: surRIHL Showcase volume 6
programme.desc: A curated playlist of AI-created music videos by surRIHL.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: A soft, futuristic world where flooded alleyways become neighborhoods, old vending machines still glow at night, people dance by the water instead of doomscrolling, and life moves slow enough to actually notice it.

programme.title: NYC & Croatia

programme.title: Bread Masters
programme.desc: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

programme.title: Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
programme.desc: Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Guayabera World
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: The Art of the Egg
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: The Famous Pastes of Spices
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: A Mayan League of their Own
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: A Day With Hugo
programme.desc: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Yucatán Meats
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
programme.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: The Best Tacos In Mérida
programme.desc: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Nazi Overlord
programme.desc: Against the background of the D-Day invasion, a US military unit must rescue a brilliant British scientist, who is held captive by the most dangerous SS guards, deep in enemy territory. The Allies' victory depends on the success of this mission.

programme.title: 2012: Doomsday
programme.desc: Four strangers on a journey of faith are drawn to a temple in the heart of Mexico on December 21, 2012. For the Mayans it is the last recorded day. For NASA scientists it is a cataclysmic polar shift. For the rest of us, it is Doomsday.

programme.title: Hold Your Breath
programme.desc: A group of friends on a roadtrip explore a cemetery where the ghost of a notorious serial killer jumps from body to body, killing his victims one by one.

programme.title: Escape from Altura
programme.desc: 10K nearly loses everything as Panic and anti-Talker sentiments flare after an explosion derails the vote.

programme.title: Insect
programme.desc: After ecological disaster causes the collapse of modern civilization, two sisters venture out from their fortified compound when their mother is severely wounded after scavenging bandits attempt to raid their home. The only advantage the sisters have is a super-charged armored muscle car.

programme.title: Ghosthunters
programme.desc: When one of their own loses his wife and daughter at the hands of a serial killer, a team of ghost hunters is determined to capture the spirits of the loved ones so their spirits can finally rest in peace. But as the team goes deeper into the house, the ghosts become more hostile, and the group discovers the true secrets of the house and its murderer.

programme.title: Alien Predator
programme.desc: A black ops reconnaissance team is sent to investigate the crash of an unidentified aircraft. There, they discover that they are being hunted by an alien expedition to Earth.

programme.title: 666: The Child
programme.desc: After a plane crash, where a boy is the only survivor, a childless couple adopts him and soon discovers he is something very powerful, something very dark. This small boy is the Beast, and with him, he carries the Beginning of the End.

programme.title: Almighty Thor
programme.desc: When the demon god Loki destroys the fortress of Valhalla and steals the Hammer of Invincibility, only the young hero Thor can protect Earth from armageddon.

programme.title: Philly Feast
programme.desc: Out to get Cassandra back, her bizarre and dangerous "family" of cannibals catches up with the team and kidnaps Addy, endangering the mission.

programme.title: Jungle Run
programme.desc: A search for their missing father turns deadly when sibling adventurers find themselves viciously attacked by jungle animals. But as they fight back against the relentless onslaught they start to realize something much more sinister may be behind the attacks.

programme.title: Zombie Road
programme.desc: Our Heroes manage to finally track Murphy down and are introduced to "Z-Weed," an ultra-potent strain of marijuana grown in zombie compost. They go on a quest for "Batch 47," a potential cure for the Zombie Virus.

programme.title: Ape vs. Mecha Ape
programme.desc: Recognizing the destructive power of the giant Ape, the military makes its own battle-ready, A.I. Mecha Ape. Its first practical test goes horribly wrong, leaving the military no choice but to release the imprisoned giant Ape to stop the robot.

programme.title: No Mercy: Part 1
programme.desc: In this "FLASHBACK MOVIE," the old crew meet a feral kid who leads them to Mercy Laboratories, a mysterious compound of survivors awaiting the return of "The Man," a villain of the Apocalypse who carries around a list of soon-to-disappear people.

programme.title: Ardennes Fury
programme.desc: As the Battle of the Bulge rages on, an American tank unit gets trapped behind Nazi lines. With just hours before the bombs of Operation Ardennes Fury fall, the tank's commander makes the risky decision to rescue an orphanage.

programme.title: Street Racer
programme.desc: After recovering from a tragic accident, a former street racer struggles to redeem himself and join the elite racing world.

programme.title: 24 Hours to D-Day
programme.desc: Just hours before D-Day, American Special Forces are tasked with parachuting in the dead of night into German-con- trolled France to guide the 101st Airborne assault ahead of the landings at Normandy. They must work together, avoid German capture, and get location and drop zone beacons on all before the Allied invasion of France begins.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Crocosaurus
programme.desc: The massive prehistoric shark has survived the last battle, and the world is again threatened when a new, more dangerous foe is discovered in the jungles of Africa.

programme.title: Shapeshifter
programme.desc: Inmates and guards alike become trapped in a maximum security prison when they fall prey to a demonic beast that feeds on human flesh.

programme.title: Zoombies
programme.desc: When a strange virus quickly spreads through a safari park and turns all the zoo animals undead, those left in the park must stop the creatures before they escape and zombify the whole city.

programme.title: Social Nightmare
programme.desc: An A-student's life is turned upside-down when inappropriate status updates and photos appear on her online profile. Soon, she learns that even her life is in danger.

programme.title: Doc's Stoned History
programme.desc: Skeezy and Sketchy re-enact Doc's stories of the Founding Fathers. Warren and the others search for the bizkit bakery and the secret ingredient in them.

programme.title: Corporate Retreat
programme.desc: Our Heroes find themselves with a group of white-collar survivors and someone tries to kill Murphy. Suddenly faced with a possible killer in their midst, our Heroes play a dangerous game of "Clue"-with zombies!

programme.title: Devil's Triangle
programme.desc: When a group of marine biologists crash land in the Bermuda Triangle, they realize they have stumbled into the lost city of Atlantis. But they quickly discover the city isn't friendly, and its humanoid inhabitants are planning worldwide domination using the piles of weapons and technology that have fallen through the Triangle over the centuries.

programme.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programme.desc: Due to a scientific experiment gone awry, a research team ends up in a strange land below the earth's crust. There they must fend off a series of strange creatures, including vicious dinosaurs and spiders. Meanwhile, above ground, Emily Radford helps military official Joseph Harnet with his plan to save the stranded research team. Their strategy is to use a high-powered drill to bore their way to the researchers, one of whom is Emily's sister.

programme.title: Invasion of the Pod People
programme.desc: After a woman's closest friends and co-workers undergo extreme personality changes, she begins to suspect that they have been replaced by malevolent alien invaders.

programme.title: Super Cyclone
programme.desc: When a super cyclone threatens the entire American eastern seaboard, a lone meteorologist and a petroleum engineer must battle the elements to stop the threat.

programme.title: No Mercy: Part 2
programme.desc: In this "FLASHBACK MOVIE," the old crew meet a feral kid who leads them to Mercy Laboratories, a mysterious compound of survivors awaiting the return of "The Man," a villain of the Apocalypse who carries around a list of soon-to-disappear people.

programme.title: The Day the Earth Stopped
programme.desc: Hundreds of massive intergalactic robots appear in all of the major world capitals with an ultimatum: Prove the value of human civilization or be destroyed.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: Murphy is captured by an overly enthusiastic and slightly unbalanced zombie fan, "The Collector." Murphy must match wits with the Collector if he's to survive, much less escape.

programme.title: The Terminators
programme.desc: In the near future, people utilize cyborgs for labor, but the vastly intelligent robots rebel against their masters and begin to take over human civilization through mass destruction. A small group of survivors, led by Sheriff Reed Carpenter (A Martinez), plans to stop the cyborgs, tapping inventor Kurt Ross (Jeremy London) for help. Using a space shuttle designed by Ross, Carpenter and his team head for a control center in outer space that has the power to shut down the machines.

programme.title: Transmorphers
programme.desc: A race of alien robots has conquered the Earth and forced humanity underground. After three hundred years of domination, a small group of humans develop a plan to defeat the mechanical invaders in the ultimate battle between man and machine.

programme.title: Meteor Moon
programme.desc: When a meteor crashes into the moon and shifts its axis, Earth's gravity pulls the moon into the path of the planet. Now, a group of scientists must figure out how to stop the moon from hitting the earth before it's too late.

programme.title: 3 Musketeers
programme.desc: Alexandra D'Artagnan, junior NSA officer, uncovers a plot to assasinate the President of the United States and enlists the help of three infamous international spies to stop the threat.

programme.title: In a New York Minute
programme.desc: Kourtney gets the opportunity of a lifetime when she's offered a role on 'One Life To Live'. Kim must decide between attending Scott's work event or obeying her mother's commands.

programme.title: One Last Dash
programme.desc: Kim considers moving to New York City; Scott buys a ring for Kourtney and contemplates marriage.

programme.title: Trouble in Paradise
programme.desc: Kourtney, Khloé, and Scott have arrived in the Hamptons; Scott has anxiety about being in his late parents' hometown; Khloé sets off on a romantic getaway to South Africa with her new boyfriend.

programme.title: What's That Racquet?
programme.desc: After Kourtney tells Scott off for breaking the boundaries they've set for their relationship, Scott tries to get back in her good graces.

programme.title: Party Crashing
programme.desc: Kourtney flies to LA to confront Kim for using her home for North's birthday party without her permission; Scott finds himself in the hospital after excessive partying.

programme.title: 12 Steps and 30 Candles
programme.desc: Scott finally makes the decision to check into rehab, but his commitment to stay wavers with each day; Khloé struggles with the realization that her life isn't where she imagined it would be as her 30th birthday gets closer.

programme.title: Aftershocks
programme.desc: Kourtney and Scott try to steer clear of repeating their past mistakes; Kim start to doubt her best friend's loyalty when family secrets are leaked to the media.

programme.title: Kaptain Kourtney and Skipper Scott
programme.desc: Khloé arranges for her and Scott to host a podcast together, taking her support of Scott to another level; Kourtney declares that she is a trained sailor, Khloé and Scott elect to test her skills on the open water.

programme.title: Riding Dirty
programme.desc: When Khloé revives her love for horseback riding, Scott and Kourtney make a bet on how long she will last; Kourtney and Kim try to break Kris's crabby mood.

programme.title: There's No Smoke Without Fire Island
programme.desc: When Scott is consumed by his negative affiliations with the Hamptons, he chooses to leave early; Khloe and Kourtney hire a new Dash Doll as a favor to Bruce.

programme.title: A House Divided
programme.desc: Scott is still not able to go into his late parents' house, so Kourtney starts fixing it up, hoping that she can convince him to keep it; Meanwhile, Kourtney gets upset when Khloé starts fraternizing with the Dash Dolls.

programme.title: Best Friends With Benefits
programme.desc: When Khloé enjoys a night of drinking, Kourtney gets angry and accuses her of recklessly putting Scott's sobriety in jeopardy; after Malika drunkenly kisses Khloé, Khloé starts to question what their friendship really means.

programme.title: The Honeymoon is Over
programme.desc: Kim and Kris join Kourtney and Scott in New York City, but things don't run as smoothly as planned.

programme.title: Go Get Your Man
programme.desc: Khloe helps her sisters.

programme.title: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Kim's decision to get off birth control causes turmoil; Kris J. finds a friend in Scott in New York City.

programme.title: True Colors
programme.desc: Kim feels betrayed when Jonathan writes a tell-all book about her; Scott wants to reconnect with his Jewish roots.

programme.title: Questionable Actions
programme.desc: Kris H. questions Jonathan's sexuality; Scott makes an impulse buy; Kourt takes interest in coupons.

programme.title: Cats Away, Mice Play
programme.desc: Kourtney and Kim go to Mystic, Connecticut while the boys sneak off to Toronto and get in some trouble.

programme.title: Kim Takes Dubai
programme.desc: Kim has more fun in Dubai without Kris J.; Kourt and Khloe prank Kris H.

programme.title: Family Therapy
programme.desc: Kim takes her relationship frustrations out on her family; Khloe tries to help Scott and Kourt with their sleeping arrangements.

programme.title: Voices From Beyond
programme.desc: Kim confesses the reality about her marriage to Kourt; Kris's sister visits.

programme.title: Goodbye, New York
programme.desc: The couples say goodbye to New York; Kim makes a decision about her marriage.

programme.title: Time to Dash
programme.desc: During a trip to Miami, a major department store makes an offer to purchase Dash; Kourtney struggles to enjoy herself while in Scott's presence; Khloé keeps Kim in the dark about her new relationship.

programme.title: Paris
programme.desc: Kourtney is eager to experience Paris Fashion Week with Kim and see Kendall walk the runway for the first time, but their trip to the city of love takes a dark turn when Kim is robbed at gunpoint.

programme.title: The Aftermath
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Paris, Kim struggles to cope with frightening reminders of the robbery, Kendall wrestles with her decision to prosecute an unstable trespasser and Kris makes it her mission to heighten security for the entire family.

programme.title: Kim's Last Ditch Effort
programme.desc: Kim undergoes one final procedure on her uterus in an attempt to carry another baby, but suffers from dangerous complications; Khloé worries about her business successes; Rob must learn to ignore criticism from his family.

programme.title: When It Rains, It Pours
programme.desc: Kim begins to ease back into her public life, but is blindsided by some upsetting news about Kanye; Khloé is pressured to mend her strained relationship with Cait; the family speculates about Kourtney and Scott; Rob welcomes his first baby.

programme.title: When It Rains, It Pours
programme.desc: After receiving some troubling news about Kanye while in New York for the Angel Ball, Kim rushes home to his aid; Kendall worries that a bad review from Vogue could jeopardize her modeling career; Khloé clashes with Malika over priorities.

programme.title: The Ex Files
programme.desc: After a fight between Rob and Chyna, the sisters feel a duty to protect their brother; Kris tries to rebuild her relationship with Cait; Kim tries to convince Khloé to hold onto her old mementos by making an ex-box.

programme.title: Guilt Trip
programme.desc: Scott becomes devastated when he hears a rumor about Kourtney; Kim returns to work and fears she might not be cut out for her public lifestyle anymore; Kendall gets upset with Caitlyn when her efforts to spend time with her dad are taken for granted.

programme.title: Family Trippin' Part 1
programme.desc: After Kim busts Scott with a girl in Dubai, the family is surprised Kourtney allowed him on the family trip; the sisters discover Scott has invited yet another girl to join him in Costa Rica, the family decides it's time for Kourtney to confront him.

programme.title: Family Trippin' Part 2
programme.desc: The family confronts Scott about his unwelcome guest; Kourtney informs him that he's ruined any chance of getting back together; Khloé is fed up with her family's attitude; Kim anxiously prepares to testify against the men who robbed her in Paris.

programme.title: Classic Cars and Vintage Eggs
programme.desc: Kim and Kourtney force Khloé to take a sentimental sister trip to Palm Springs to relive some of their fondest childhood memories; to save his relationship, Rob meets with a life coach; Kris receives an outrageous proposition from a royal family.

programme.title: Decisions, Decisions
programme.desc: Rob struggles to find a way to be civil with Chyna for their daughter; Khloé puts Kourtney through a series of silly tests to cure her indecisiveness; Kim jets to New York with Kylie for Kanye's highly-anticipated Yeezy fashion show.

programme.title: Loyalties and Royalties

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Her Alibi
programme.desc: Mystery novelist Phil Blackwood has written countless bestsellers, but he's having trouble finding inspiration for his latest book, so he goes to the courthouse to observe real criminals in action. There he encounters Nina, a gorgeous immigrant charged with a gruesome murder. Convinced she's not guilty, Phil furnishes Nina with an alibi and a place to stay. But, as the two begin to fall in love, Phil finds he has grave doubts about her innocence.

programme.title: Little Children
programme.desc: A small town hides a sordid underbelly of adultery and perversion.

programme.title: The Accidental Tourist
programme.desc: A travel writer hates to travel and loves order, until everything changes.

programme.title: Red Sonja
programme.desc: Power-hungry Queen Gedren (Sandahl Bergman) captures the priestesses guarding the Talisman, a mystical orb that created and can destroy the world. But one of the priestesses escapes and seeks out her warrior sister, Red Sonja (Brigitte Nielsen), to warn her about Gedren's plan for world domination. Lord Kalidor (Arnold Schwarzenegger), the Talisman's keeper, insists on helping Sonja, and though she scorns the assistance of any man, she soon gains respect for Kalidor's fighting prowess.

programme.title: I Am Sam
programme.desc: A man with an intellectual disability fights for custody of his daughter.

programme.title: Arthur 2: On the Rocks
programme.desc: The world's richest and most tipsy wit, is alive, well and living in style!

programme.title: Alex & Emma
programme.desc: An author with a case of writer's block hires a stenographer to help him.

programme.title: Love Affair
programme.desc: Two star-crossed lovers vow to meet again if they still love each other.

programme.title: The Right Stuff
programme.desc: NASA recruits seven test pilots for the Mercury Space Program.

programme.title: Ghosts of Mississippi
programme.desc: A district attorney reopens the case against the murderer of Medgar Evers.

programme.title: Message in a Bottle
programme.desc: A lonely woman's discovery of a man's letter in a bottle leads to love.

programme.title: The Prince of Pennsylvania
programme.desc: A teen develops an unlikely friendship with a hippie who runs a drive-in.

programme.title: Collateral Damage
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as a man on a mission of vengeance.

programme.title: Chariots of Fire
programme.desc: In the class-obsessed and religiously divided United Kingdom of the early 1920s, two determined young runners train for the 1924 Paris Olympics. Eric Liddell (Ian Charleson), a devout Christian born to Scottish missionaries in China, sees running as part of his worship of God's glory and refuses to train or compete on the Sabbath. Harold Abrahams (Ben Cross) overcomes anti-Semitism and class bias, but neglects his beloved sweetheart Sybil (Alice Krige) in his single-minded quest.

programme.title: Almost Heroes
programme.desc: Two explorers are racing Lewis and Clark to the Pacific Ocean in 1804. Edwards (Matthew Perry) is a glory-seeking fop who's out of his league, Hunt (Chris Farley) is a slovenly, clumsy tracker with a soft spot for toilet humor. Along with a team of misfits and losers, the duo wreaks havoc on the American frontier.

programme.title: The Spitfire Grill
programme.desc: Percy looks to start over in a quiet town by taking a job at a local cafe.

programme.title: Best Friends
programme.desc: A couple learns the differences between being married rather than friends.

programme.title: Lost in Space
programme.desc: The Robinsons are selected to be the first family to colonize outer space.

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Dylan Ramsey (David Spade) is getting ready to open his own restaurant, but he's become preoccupied his new neighbor, a gorgeous Frenchwoman named Lila (Sophie Marceau). When Dylan doesn't have much luck talking to her, he decides that the way to her heart may be through her beloved dog, Jack. Abducting the canine, Dylan hopes to win Lila's affection when he returns Jack safe and sound, but soon the scheming guy has to deal with numerous unforeseen problems that jeopardize his plan.

programme.title: Club Paradise
programme.desc: A Chicago fireman holds onto his dream of owning a tropical island resort.

programme.title: Joe Versus the Volcano
programme.desc: Joe Banks (Tom Hanks) is dying, apparently. This is good news, since his life was not much worth living anyway. On the upside, a strange millionaire (Lloyd Bridges) offers Joe a way to die with meaning and dignity: by hurling himself into a volcano. With plenty of spending cash and an ensemble of new luggage, Joe embarks on an absurdist journey to his demise, guided by two very disparate sisters, and trying to puzzle out the meaning of existence.

programme.title: One Crazy Summer
programme.desc: After graduating from high school, art school hopeful Hoops McCann (John Cusack) struggles to complete his application to the Rhode Island School of Design. Resigning himself to a summer of boredom, McCann agrees to go along with his best friend, George Calamari (Joel Murray), on a family trip to Nantucket, Mass. But, after McCann and Calamari meet rocker-in-distress Cassandra (Demi Moore), it suddenly looks like it's going to be "one crazy summer."

programme.title: The Hudsucker Proxy
programme.desc: Greedy executive Sidney J. Mussburger (Paul Newman) hopes to take control of the company he works for by purchasing a majority share -- but he must first devalue the stock. So he convinces the board to appoint know-nothing recent graduate Norville Barnes (Tim Robbins). But Mussburger's plot backfires when Barnes' latest invention succeeds, thereby increasing the company's value. Worse yet, undercover reporter Amy Archer (Jennifer Jason Leigh) has the scoop on Mussburger's shady dealings.

programme.title: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Nash must protect Lynette from Asian mobsters when she unknowingly becomes involved in a forgery ring; Joe's father visits.

programme.title: Touchdown
programme.desc: Several armored cars and their drivers disappear; a football star needs to find "the most beautiful girl in the world"; Nick is reluctant to use a hearing aid.

programme.title: Sacraments
programme.desc: Metal heads go on a crime spree; Nash learns of Cassidy and Evan's relationship; Nick gets an overdue Navy Cross.

programme.title: High Fall
programme.desc: Nash's ex-lover masterminds a real estate scam that leaves him destitute; Joe destroys his own home while trying to improve it.

programme.title: Impostors
programme.desc: Nash and Joe pose as gay detectives in San Francisco's Castro district while trying to find a Cher impersonator's stolen wig.

programme.title: Hot Prowler
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for a psychopath who telecasts videotapes of his crimes on the Internet; Joe considers suing a restaurant.

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: Nash and Joe scramble to find enough evidence to prove the innocence of a man on death row; a parent sues Joe, claiming his daughter is mistreating his son in preschool.

programme.title: Apocalypse Nash
programme.desc: Nash and Joe share a jail cell while awaiting trial over the murder of three fellow police officers during a drug bust.

programme.title: The Tourist
programme.desc: Nash's ex-wife arrives from Paris and informs him that a bureaucratic snafu fouled up their divorce 12 years earlier.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: Nash and Caitlin pose as a married couple while investigating wife-swapping parties; Joe helps steal a corpse.

programme.title: Warplay
programme.desc: Wealthy businessmen play a bizarre war game that leads to deadly consequences; Evan's lover is the assistant district attorney's fiancée.

programme.title: Firestorm
programme.desc: Nash's mysterious friend helps in the search for a murderous arsonist; Joe tries to throw a surprise party for Nash.

programme.title: Hardball
programme.desc: Nash and Joe attempt to prevent a zealous INS agent from deporting a baseball star who is in the country illegally.

programme.title: Mystery Dance
programme.desc: Caitlin reveals details about her past to Nash; Joe battles a strict exercise and diet program; Cassidy and Nick team up for a tango competition.

programme.title: Shoot the Moon
programme.desc: Caitlin accidentally shoots Nash in the posterior; his pompous nemesis (Daniel Roebuck) replaces him.

programme.title: Gimme Shelter
programme.desc: While Nash pursues a gang of teenage carjackers, Joe goes undercover at a department store to catch a thief.

programme.title: Superstition
programme.desc: Nash must protect a young singer from obsessed fans intent on kidnapping her; Joe's attempt to buy his wife a car at a police auction backfires.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: Nash's daughter faces death after a car crash; a sniper is loose in the city; Joe battles rats; guest Dee Wallace Stone.

programme.title: Pump Action
programme.desc: An undercover police officer joins forces with Nash to put a choke hold on marauding bodybuilders who are pumped up on illegal steroids.

programme.title: Hide and Seek
programme.desc: Nash and Joe try to find the governor of California after he slips out of sight, fearing the exposure of a possible sex scandal involving his mistress.

programme.title: Boomtown
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for a serial bomber; Cassidy must perform topless in her new play while her father is in the audience; Nick befriends a noisy band.

programme.title: Angel of Mercy
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for a serial killer; Caitlin and Joe coach girls' soccer teams; Harvey reconciles with his estranged wife.

programme.title: Power Play
programme.desc: Nash and Joe must cure an amnesiac to rescue a man from the Russian mob; Joe undergoes fertility tests.

programme.title: Vendetta
programme.desc: Nash must protect Caitlin after she is portrayed as a kinky sex addict on the Internet by a former cop who she helped send to jail for wife beating.

programme.title: Crash and Burn
programme.desc: A series of robberies leads Nash and Joe to a group of women whose husbands are imprisoned for similar heists.

programme.title: Frisco Blues
programme.desc: Internal affairs demotes Nash and Joe to walking a beat; Cortez becomes a traffic officer; Leek goes to homicide; Caitlin works vice detail.

programme.title: Goodbye Kiss
programme.desc: The unit faces permanent closure; Caitlin plans to leave; Nash and Jake Cage (Steve Austin) compete for Caitlin.

programme.title: Truth and Consequences
programme.desc: The team searches for an actress's assassin; Caitlin moves in with Nash; Inger wants Joe to go to Sweden.

programme.title: Trade Off
programme.desc: Nash must save an 8-year-old child who has been kidnapped; kidnappers mistakenly take a boy whose parents have no money.

programme.title: Smash and Grab
programme.desc: Thieves pose as firefighters responding to jewelry store fires only to steal the goods; the unit must uncover a litigious in-line skater's insurance scam.

programme.title: Girl Trouble
programme.desc: Nash must save Cassidy from drug dealers who mistake her for another woman; Joe meets the person he has been flirting with online.

programme.title: High Society
programme.desc: Nash and Caitlin ask Jake Cage (Steve Austin) to help identify a dangerous fugitive at a posh wedding.

programme.title: Curveball
programme.desc: Nash and the team must track down a corrupt official who plans to leave the country with $5 million in pension funds; Caitlin accidentally throws one of Nash's prized possessions through a window.

programme.title: Split Decision
programme.desc: An ex-con claims to suffer from multiple personalities when he is caught robbing banks; Nick moves to a high-class retirement home; Harvey confronts Evan about his substance abuse.

programme.title: Get Bananas
programme.desc: Nash and Joe must protect a famous chimpanzee from animal rights activists wishing to release him into the jungle; Jake Cage searches for a wanted murderer; Evan pursues a drug dealer without Nash's approval.

programme.title: Crosstalk
programme.desc: Nash tracks a paranoid, delusional man who randomly kills cell-phone users; Nash and Joe investigate the decapitation of a dummy; Joe's dreams about Caitlin interfere with his waking hours.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: Nash and the team track down a vigilante intent on bringing murderers to justice; Caitlin and Joe form a partnership to deliver doughnuts via the Internet.

programme.title: Rip Off
programme.desc: The team must track down two gangs of robbers, one of which has an informant in its ranks who is tipping off the rival one.

programme.title: Skin Trade
programme.desc: Caitlin is undercover as a madam to stop a pornography and sex-slavery ring; Nash calls Caitlin by his ex-wife's name.

programme.title: Liar's Poker
programme.desc: Nash is undercover as a favor to an FBI agent; Inger and Lucia return from Sweden; Nick's poker buddies get him in trouble.

programme.title: El Diablo
programme.desc: While Nash investigates the death of a woman who plunged off a balcony, Joe gives Evan a second chance to redeem himself.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: Nash and Joe's client is killed when the building in which they are meeting explodes; Joe's mother-in-law and Nick fall in love.

programme.title: Cop Out
programme.desc: Nash must catch a man who dons a police uniform and terrorizes people; Nash and Caitlin must learn to get along during work; Nick wants his driver's license.

programme.title: Line of Sight
programme.desc: A drug dealer tries to corner the market by killing his competition; Evan and Cassidy discover they are being stalked when they begin dating again.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: Nash must infiltrate a thief's base of operation in order to catch him; Joe protects a mean-spirited restaurant critic; Evan returns to the unit; Caitlin may become Nash's boss.

programme.title: Hard Cell
programme.desc: Nash must help a convict in exchange for valuable information; Joe has a hard time with a delivery boy.

programme.title: Missing Key
programme.desc: Joe is the target for murder when a woman plants a key with him; Nick performs in Cassidy's play; Harvey is involved with a complicated woman.

programme.title: Jackpot
programme.desc: A police chief is murdered, and Jake Cage (Steve Austin) returns to assist Nash in the investigation.

programme.title: Jackpot
programme.desc: Nash is undercover in Las Vegas to stop an Asian kingpin; Evan is shot in the line of duty; Cassidy goes to the police academy.

programme.title: Rock and a Hard Place
programme.desc: Soon after Nash's daughter, Cassidy, joins the Special Investigation Unit, an escaped felon convicted with tainted evidence kidnaps her and Joe.

programme.title: Jump Start
programme.desc: Nash flips when he finds out that Cassidy played a hooker to nab a South African diamond smuggler; a new investigator joins the force.

programme.title: Lap Dance
programme.desc: Nash gets more than just a favor from a former lover when trying to take down a criminal with stolen cruise-missile secrets.

programme.title: Land Pirates
programme.desc: Nash and Joe are hot on the trail of a clever ring of thieves that preys on San Francisco's elite; Nash discovers the secret behind a nun's double life.

programme.title: ManHunt
programme.desc: A drug gang knocks over a DEA evidence warehouse and proves elusive for the members of the team; Antwon has a seizure while chasing down the leader of the gang.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) find out that someone has been "borrowing" the name of their detective agency. Guest stars: Jenna Lewis, Joel Klug, Sean Kenniff and Gervase Peterson of "Survivor."

programme.title: WW2 Hospital Haunting
programme.desc: Built in the early 1900's and now used as offices, a former world war 2 hospital has become the new home for something supernatural. Strange voices, eerie footsteps and the sounds of painful screams have all been reported. What will be uncovered tonight?

programme.title: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 2
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension Team are ready for act II at the New Mills Arts Theatre. With so much apparent activity happening at this unassuming theatre the team just couldn't leave when so much more seemed to be promised. And more there was. Has one of the team been singled out as a cry for help from spirit takes hold and has everyone reeling from what they witness?

programme.title: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar.

programme.title: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 1
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team travel to Derbyshire to investigate the New Mills Arts Theatre. This quirky little building has played host to many famous acts and world renowned plays but has a little known secret that it's allegedly Haunted. With unexplained voices coming from the auditorium and shadows witnessed on the stage, The activity will get so intense it will leave the team in a spin!

programme.title: Haunted Secrets of The Carlton
programme.desc: The team explore The Carlton, a location with a dark and mysterious past. As they investigate reports of strange noises, shadowy figures, and unexplained activity, they delve deeper into the eerie history surrounding the building. Will the spirits haunting The Carlton reveal their secrets, or will the team leave with more questions than answers?

programme.title: Loud Ghosts of the Hall
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension continue their investigation into Champness Hall and come face to face with paranormal activity that is caught on camera and seek out the paranormal entities haunting the location.

programme.title: The Haunting of the Forgotten Chapel
programme.desc: In this episode, the team heads to an abandoned chapel, where strange paranormal events have been reported for decades. From eerie knocks on the doors to footsteps echoing around them, the investigators experience chilling encounters as they try to communicate with the spirits that seem to haunt this site.

programme.title: Poltergeist Haunting The Station Hotel - Part 2
programme.desc: Sean continues his investigation at The Station Hotel and it appears his presence is not welcomed by the spirits. This is one experience of the paranormal that leaves a mark in Sean's memory forever.

programme.title: Poltergeist Haunting The Station Hotel - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to Ashton-Under-Lyne to investigate poltergeist activity claims in a truly local pub. It's believed that it's not just the locals that return to haunt here. Sean comes face to face with the activity in a night he will never forget.

programme.title: Haunting of The Sad Cavalier at The Ring O Bells - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to Middleton, Manchester to investigate claims that a sad cavalier named Edward is haunting this location. Ring O Bells has also been used for druid rituals. Will he be able to summon any spirits tonight?

programme.title: Haunted Escape Room at Moviescape - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to a haunted escape room attraction and although the sets are dressed to scare, something more sinister seems to be lurking here. Will Sean escape unscathed tonight? Items from the Enfield haunting and Amityville haunting reside here, could they be causing havoc?

programme.title: Lock Keepers Haunting at Lock 91
programme.desc: Sean heads to Manchester to investigate a lock keepers cottage that was built in 1804 and it appears that the spirits are still watching over the building and terrifying its customers.

programme.title: Ghosts of The Asylum
programme.desc: Paul and Sean visit one very haunted Asylum in Manchester and come to face with ghostly souls that are haunting the building. The Asylum housed the criminally insane and it would appear, as the building closed, some of them never left!

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: The New York Times labeled Bramber in Southern England, the most haunted village. From Bramber Castle's ruins, delve into the tragic tales: starved noble children, medieval lovers' memories, a ghost-solving murder, a lover's accidental killing, and a Victorian author's unfulfilled death wish haunting his hometown.

Things soon come to a head when the buddies attend a party at the upscale home of a young and wealthy tech entrepreneur.

programme.title: The Dirty Dozen
programme.desc: Keyshawn and Lil' Murda embark on a new adventure; meanwhile, Mercedes ventures into uncharted territory.

programme.title: The Nick Gets Jealous Episode
programme.desc: Nick asks Suzanne to help pro basketball player Ray Savage plan a children's charity event, but gets worried when he learns of Ray's reputation as a womanizer.

programme.title: The Test Taker Episode
programme.desc: Kevin assists Frankie in preparing for an exam, but Frankie offers a bribe to persuade Kevin to take the test on his behalf.

programme.title: The Compatibility Test Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne meets a relationship adviser and becomes convinced that she and Nick are having compatibility issues.

programme.title: The Good Cop, Bad Cop Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne is tired of being the bad cop while Nick plays the good cop with the kids, so they decide to switch places.

programme.title: The Mr. Almost Episode
programme.desc: When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink; the results are not so bubbly.

programme.title: The Play Date Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, her friend Danielle and husband Steve; the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.

programme.title: The Lindsey Gets High Episode
programme.desc: Lindsey freaks out when a friend offers her a drug; she gets a lesson on drugs from former child-star Todd Bridges who takes her on a wild ride.

programme.title: The Liar, Liar Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.

programme.title: The Fight Party Episode
programme.desc: Nick's boxing match party unexpectedly takes over the family room on the same night Suzanne's book group is meeting in the living room.

programme.title: The Nick's Kid Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne learns the mother of Kevin's new friend Nathan is Nick's old fling; she suspects that Nathan could be Nick's son.

programme.title: The Kevin Gets a Commercial Episode
programme.desc: Kevin auditions for a commercial for the mall burger joint and ends up being replaced by a famous kid actor that looks just like him.

programme.title: The Suzanne's Surprise Party Episode
programme.desc: Nick and the kids throw a birthday party for Suzanne because she has never had one.

programme.title: Just the Way You Are
programme.desc: Hattie throws a surprise party for Linda to make her feel more appreciated by everyone.

programme.title: Love for Linda
programme.desc: Linda's son Danny tries to plan his mom a surprise baby shower.

programme.title: Ella and Curtis
programme.desc: Linda seeks help from Ella Payne to plan her reception; Curtis wants Floyd to pay him back for his investment.

programme.title: Drew's Feelings
programme.desc: Drew reveals her love for Danny.

programme.title: Caroline and P.J.
programme.desc: Linda has a hard time figuring out how to tell P.J. and Caroline that she is engaged to their father.

programme.title: Spring Cleaning
programme.desc: Hattie prepares for spring cleaning at the diner; Linda explains why she can't move in with Phillip.

programme.title: An Empty Palate
programme.desc: Linda, in a completely rational mood, threatens to call the wedding off if Philip does not change the furniture in his house.

programme.title: Love Thy Decorator
programme.desc: Philip allows Linda to redecorate the house in whatever way she chooses.

programme.title: The Promotion
programme.desc: After Hattie finds out that Danny got a promotion, she asks him to help pay for Linda's wedding.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Danny shows Drew's cousin around.

programme.title: Bring 'Em Out
programme.desc: Sage Odom revises his stadium tour into a grassroots movement with a purpose; things heat up between Rigo and Colette, but lies and doubts are constantly present; Odalie tries to keep Angel's affections.

programme.title: Sleep When U Die
programme.desc: It's a battle for control over High Water and dreams of power, fame and fortune; many secrets are revealed, including the real murderer of East-O and the true identity of Saint Clip.

programme.title: Closure
programme.desc: M-Chuck has unconventional ideas about closure; Cam sees his father in a new light; Reggie and Trent head north.

programme.title: Feel Free to Comment
programme.desc: Cam and Allison clash with some fans; Reggie advises Missy to think twice about taking on a job; Cassie's podcast deals with a hot topic.

programme.title: Lee Daniels' The Butler
programme.desc: After leaving the South as a young man and finding employment at an elite hotel in Washington, D.C., Cecil Gaines (Forest Whitaker) gets the opportunity of a lifetime when he is hired as a butler at the White House. Over the course of three decades, Cecil has a front-row seat to history and the inner workings of the Oval Office. However, his commitment to his "First Family" leads to tension at home, alienating his wife (Oprah Winfrey) and causing conflict with his anti-establishment son.

programme.desc: When a young girl and her dying mother are joined by a black male cook who comes to live with them, little do they know that their lives are about to change forever.
